nom: medicube Age-R Glutathione Glow Milky Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer reports the toner keeps oiliness in check while still moisturizing, without stripping natural oils.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose skin was dry, patchy and scaly from a compromised barrier and one with dry, sensitive skin allergic to most sunscreens, report the toner keeps their skin moisturized and glowing even in hot, humid or windy dry weather.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and good hydration, but one long-time user reports a bottle she suspects was fake or reformulated caused her skin to burn badly, in contrast to the original product which she found soothing.
segments.mature: A 63-year-old long-time user reports her face feels youthful and soft, with family commenting that she looks younger.

concerns.aging: One long-term user in her 60s reports her skin feels more youthful and family have commented she looks younger; another reviewer notes she cannot yet judge any anti-aging effect after only a short time, and a third mentions the peptide content targets firmness but expects results only after a few months.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report the toner is hydrating and leaves skin feeling plump, soft or moisturized, including in hot humid weather and windy dry conditions, with several noting it does not feel heavy, sticky or greasy; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a bottle she suspects was counterfeit or reformulated burned her skin badly, in contrast to the original formula which she found soothing; every other reviewer who addresses irritation, including several with sensitive skin, reports no redness, stinging or rash.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer whose skin barrier was compromised, leaving her skin dry, patchy and scaly, reports her skin felt soft and moisturized after the first use and continued to improve over two weeks.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report dark spots, acne marks or hyperpigmentation fading and skin tone evening out with continued use; one reviewer, however, reports no brightening effect on her skin despite high expectations, describing it as simply a good moisturizer.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the toner keeps oiliness at bay without stripping the skin's natural oils, while still leaving it moisturized.

I had To wait for it to come back in stock to repurchase. (I have purchased multiple times) the second I saw the bottle I could tell. It no longer is the same color as product photo (it used to be that exact color/ratio) the minute I put it in I knew it was going to cause issues because it was BURNING when it used to be so soothing. I’ll attach photos of what I look like this morning -__- and a picture of the new bottle so you can see the color difference. My face hurts so bad. I’m pissed and want my original product back.
Tenia muchas expectativas pero no hace el efecto glow mi piel no esta mas clara, es un buen hidratante simplemente

My skin barrier was jacked up. My skin was dry, patchy and scaly....just gross and icky. My fur baby died after 16 yrs of love and constant companionship. So for a time, nothing mattered. The one day I caught a glimpse of this haggered wretched person staring back at me through the mirror. I remembered this product while mindlessly watching YouTube (Dr. Sam Ellis) and so very glad that I decided to order it. After the first use,I woke up to skin that felt soft, moisturized and glowed. If you could have seen and felt my skin from just the day before you would have been impressed too. It's been 2 weeks, I've mainly put it on at night after my double cleanse. Old acne scars are less noticeable, my skin tone overall is more even. My skin feels buttery soft to the touch and glows throughout the day. I've not been wearing makeup but I'm sure it will glide on with ease once do. I didn't give it 5 stars because it has fragrance and I prefer skincare without. It seemed like a small bottle but a little goes a long way and I'm excited to see continued results as I slowly make my way to the end of this bottle...so worth it, one of my new fav

I’ve been searching for a product that delivers that glass-skin glow, and I finally found it in this toner. It makes my skin feel soft, hydrated, and noticeably radiant. I’ve also seen my pimple dark spots fade more quickly than usual, which has been a huge plus. What I love most is that it isn’t greasy or sticky—it absorbs beautifully and leaves my skin looking fresh and healthy. Every morning, I wake up with a glow that feels natural and luminous. As someone with sensitive skin, I’m impressed that this worked so well without causing irritation. Considering it’s a Korean skincare product imported from Korea, I find the price fair for the quality and results. This has quickly become a staple in my routine, and it’s one I’ll continue to repurchase again and again.

This is truly one of the best toners I’ve ever used. It’s definitely my favorite out of all of my other toners. As someone with hyperpigmentation, glutathione works great to brighten dark spots, and that’s exactly what this toner does for me. Just all around brightens my skin complexion while also targeting hyperpigmentation. Not to mention it is extremely nourishing and just gives you this amazing glow, especially when combined with vitamin c. It might seem “greasy” at first however it’s not, it will absorb into your skin beautifully and sits perfectly under sunscreen and makeup. Honestly, it’s a great product that helps brighten and will enhance your glow with or without makeup

extraits.titre: Incredibly hydrating toner with loads of natural ingredients.
extraits.texte: I have been wearing this toner alone this summer and it has been the perfect amount of hydration for my skin. I have dry sensitive skin that is allergic to most sunscreen. It has been hot and humid in the Southwest and this toner alone has kept my skin moisturized and hydrated. This toner has a lovely light scent of peach, melon and honeysuckle. The only thing I don't like about this toner is the dispenser. I usually wash my face clean and apply the toner directly onto my face, so I prefer a spray dispenser, mainly so that I don't lose a lot of the product in a cotton pad. Other than that, I love this toner and will definitely reorder. Another great skincare product from Korea.

I've been using medicube products since December of 2024. I love all the toners especially age-r is top notch for me. Makes my face feel youthful and soft the next day. My families can see a big difference saying I'm getting younger...lol Noone believe I'm 63yrs old. I will never stop using medicube products. I recommend them.
